knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says to agree a missed-check escalation procedure and not to rely on a phone with no signal. Immediate danger goes to emergency services.
Resumption follows confirmation from the responsible person that the hazard is controlled and the plan is safe.
The record stays factual, avoids uninvolved names and does not collect unnecessary personal location history.

practicalCriteria: Learner sends a supplied set of job details (address, start and finish times, vehicle, phone) to the designated contact before starting a simulated lone job.
Learner checks in at the agreed points, using the approved method, and confirms the contact received the message.
Learner, on a supplied scenario of a missed check-in, calls the designated contact as soon as possible.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Check-in and check-out log with times and the contact who received them
Record of any missed check-in, the response and the outcome
stopWorkCriteria: Learner enters a property without confirming it is vacant and safe
Learner starts a lone job without sending the job details
